main.drop.title: Dropped files
main.drop.one_file_info:
Choose whether to open it as a new SBOM or compare it with the SBOM that is currently open.

• Open as new: closes the current SBOM and loads the file.
• Compare with current SBOM: compares the current SBOM (including unsaved edits) as A (old) with the dropped file as B (new).
